event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,580 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 66 prior macro-attempts in this family and 559 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0168/micro-0004 at 1,586 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0168/micro-0005 (FF-output pair 183/223 discarded at 98.99%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 144 and 107, values -0.0847604349 and -0.0844875574 (difference 2.729e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,579 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 2.753e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map.
